content.short: GumBall Protocol brings DeFi to the NFT market.
content.description: GumBall Protocol is a versatile deep-liquidity hub that brings DeFi capabilities to the NFT market. Launched in 2022, it enables using NFTs as collateral within a broader DeFi ecosystem. The platform uses the GumBall bonding curve to inject liquidity into NFT markets, making tokens easily tradable and allowing users to stake and borrow against their NFTs without liquidation or interest risk. For every NFT collection launched on the platform, a corresponding set of ERC20 tokens (GBTs) is issued and sold on a bonding curve; the liquidity generated by these sales remains within the bonding curves to support holders' activities.
content.meta: GumBall Protocol is a multi-purpose deep liquidity NFT & DeFi hub for the NFT market. Discover GumBall Protocol and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
